Description: Japanese SKK input engine for Fcitx5 This package provides Japanese SKK input method engine for Fcitx5, which uses libskk as its backend. . SKK stands for 'Simple Kana to Kanji conversion program'. It provide Japanese input method which convert hiragana text to kanji text.
